name: Belvaros
tagline: The centre along Piac utca, under the Great Church
description: Debrecen's main axis runs from the Great Reformed Church down Piac utca past the market hall, and the centre spreads a few blocks either side. Period buildings, the theatre, the main shops and most of the city's restaurants sit here, with trams running the length of it and everything reachable on foot.
bestFor: Anyone wanting the shortest walk to everything the city offers
pros: All services, restaurants and the market within ten minutes
Tram line the length of the district
The widest choice of flats in the city
cons: Traffic and tram noise on the main axis
Busy with shoppers through the day

name: Nagyerdo
tagline: Inside the Great Forest, with the university and the thermal baths
description: The northern end of the tram line runs into an oak forest that holds the university's main building, the stadium, a zoo and the Aquaticum thermal baths. Housing here is a mix of interwar villas and student accommodation, and the setting is the best in the city by a distance.
bestFor: Anyone who wants a forest and a thermal bath at the end of the working day
pros: Genuine oak forest for running and walking
Thermal baths and the university on the doorstep
Direct tram to the centre in ten minutes
cons: Housing supply is tight and student-dominated
Fewer everyday shops than the centre
Busy with visitors around the baths at weekends

name: Ujkert
tagline: Northwestern estates, cheap and well served
description: A large panel estate district northwest of the centre with supermarkets, schools, clinics and frequent buses. The flats are plain but functional and the rents are among the lowest in the city, which is why a good share of the international student population ends up here rather than nearer the university.
bestFor: Long stays on a student budget with everyday shopping close by
pros: Everything you need for daily life within walking distance
Frequent buses to the centre and the university
cons: Nothing to do here after dark
Fifteen to twenty minutes from the centre

name: Tocoskert
tagline: Southwestern estates with parks between the blocks
description: A residential district southwest of the centre, built as estates but with more green between the buildings than Ujkert and a large park at its heart. Shops, schools and a market are all local. It is quiet, unremarkable and cheap, which for a longer stay is often the right combination.
bestFor: Settled longer stays that value quiet and space over walkability
pros: Park and green space between the blocks
Local market and full everyday shopping
cons: No restaurant or bar scene at all
Bus rather than tram into town

name: Csapokert
tagline: Low-rise streets east of the centre, close in and quiet
description: An older district just east of the centre with single-storey houses, small gardens and narrow streets, a survival of how much of Debrecen looked before the estates. It is a ten-minute walk to Piac utca and considerably quieter, with a village texture that is unusual this close to a city centre.
bestFor: People who want a house and a garden within walking distance of the centre
pros: Ten-minute walk to the main street
Houses with gardens rather than flats
cons: Few shops and almost no cafes
Housing stock is old and variable
